written.headline: Start-up investors and founders worry about losing ally in Jensen Huang
written.summary: Investors and founders expressed concern that they have lost an ally following Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia. Nvidia held $48 billion in stakes across 229 private companies and offered $165 billion in cloud backstops as of July.

written.headline: Wall Street fears Jensen Huang's ouster will slow Nvidia's AI dealmaking
written.summary: Wall Street and industry observers worry that Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia will slow the company's aggressive AI investments and dealmaking. Sources report that Nvidia's $500 billion lending consortium is currently in flux, with at least one lender potentially exiting.

written.headline: OpenAI disbands standalone robotics team as general models take over
written.summary: OpenAI disbanded its stand-alone robotics team and reassigned its staff to the main research and Applied organizations. The company stated that models like GPT-6 Astra can be applied directly to robotics.

written.headline: Nonprofit groups sue major AI companies seeking halt to advanced development
written.summary: A coalition of nonprofit groups filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and SpaceX's AI division to block further development of advanced AI models. The lawsuit, filed in San Francisco Superior Court, alleges that the companies knowingly build systems they cannot reliably control.

written.headline: Nvidia reaffirms GPU supply plans to South Korea after Huang exit
written.summary: South Korea's science minister stated that Nvidia confirmed its commitment to deploy up to 260,000 graphics processing units in the country. The business cooperation will continue following Jensen Huang's resignation.
